notes.title: Making Coffee - Episode III
notes.notes:
[h1] What are we doing now?	[/h1]

[list]
    [*] Yesterday we developed our game saving system. Will be designed just like old fashioned videogames.
You'll be able to save in different slots, so you can decide wheter if you want to start a new game or continue your current one to improve your game stats.

    [*] We are also designing Steam Achievemets and the best way to insert them in the game.

    [*] First sprites of the next level are under construction.

[/list]

Do you have other suggestions? How do you imagine a possible way to develop a multiplayer section of the game?

notes.title: Making Coffee - Episode II
notes.notes:
Hey there! We're now designing a brand new level for Odyssee. We're working to give it a brand new gameplay.

We're planning to upload it within one month.

By the way, as requested we are also working on game-stats and other funny things.

Stay tuned with Odyssee.

Have a good life!

notes.title: Making Coffe - Episode I
notes.notes:
Hey there, this is Odyssee's dev team and that's Making Coffee episode I, a sort of blog about the status of Odyssee's Development.

Well, the Early Access version of Odyssee is coming soon. Really soon. We're just fixing some issues related to the upload.

Due to local technical problems (we're in Italy) we're facing some issues.

Anyway, stay tuned and send us any suggestion coming into your mind at info@earthandlife.it

Tchuss! Ciao!
